method.parser_recovery: 200M prompt 18 hit the peg-native chat-parser HTTP 500. Its actual 229-token output was recovered from the preserved server log, not replaced. Remaining 200M prompts and subsequent models use --skip-chat-parsing; generation settings and thinking-off template remain unchanged.
method.runtime_restart: 20M completed with one slot. A one-answer 50M serial partial was archived before a fresh full four-slot pass. The four-slot 200M run resumed after parser recovery; metadata retains previous-run details.
method.greedy_comparison: Reuse unchanged Codex ratings for 200M and stock from judge/d200/tally.json, plus correctness_d250M.json and loops_d250M.json. Earlier Haiku scores are not a matched-judge comparison.
method.strict_correctness: Evaluate the whole answer; material false claims, contradictions and wrong supporting arithmetic fail even if the first or final number is right. Formatting is separate. Nine subjective prompts are always na.
method.extension: 500M final checkpoint; prior ratings unchanged; same primary assistant and rubric.
